Earlier Xuhui Middle School (formerly the Xuhui Public School) of the main building. The school in 1850 to create, now covering 38.6 acres. Chong Si House in January 8, 1917 placed the first stone. June 20, 1918 completed, Shanghai celebrity-studded inauguration ceremony, Lu Yongxiang Songhu Hujun make generals attended the ceremony, the Qing Shanghai Shen Baochang prefectural governor attended the groundbreaking ceremony. Sung Si floor by the Belgian priest, architect and the first design sketches Disney Rendu workers, was called "new school." 1992 renamed "Si Chong floor." Chong even thought the whole building floor attic of four, presenting the French classical architectural design and ancient Greek art of combining classic architectural style. Facade of masonry, interior wooden structure based. Top also had the use of Spanish architectural style, but in the early 1990s due to serious leaking and demolition. Sung Si-floor 孟莎 style beautiful contour, and there is uneven change, is divided into Sec lower section is steep, open French-style dormer windows, the upper relatively flat, open some stingy windows, roof paved with slate gray basket. The whole building brick facade of water, hook gold seam, five sections of the longitudinal approach taken three segments, re-use triangles and mountain fancy curved window lintel on the overall design of the building. The size of each building with a hall, auditorium on the top floor, a small auditorium on the ground floor. Chong thought the building is now a small hall, office, library, music and other fine arts classrooms. Sung Si House completed in 2010 the last renovation.

description_text:
Outdoor bench 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 9316 vertices, 9020 quad faces (18040 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
DE: Ein Hydrant (von griechisch ὕδωρ hydor ‚Wasser’) ist eine Armatur zur Entnahme von Wasser aus einem Wasserverteilungssystem.
In der Regel werden durch den Wasserversorger festgelegte Hydranten als Teil der zentralen Löschwasserversorgung von Städten und Gemeinden genutzt. Er ermöglicht der Feuerwehr, aber auch öffentlichen (z. B. Straßenmeisterei, Stadtbetriebe) und privaten (z. B. Straßenreinigungsfirmen, Zeltfestveranstaltern) Nutzern die Wasserentnahme aus dem öffentlichen Wasserleitungsnetz (Sammelwasserversorgung).
Hydranten werden genutzt um eine Rohrleitung zu spülen, zu entlüften oder zu entspannen. Im Falle des Ausfalls eines Leitungsabschnittes sind sie dafür gedacht Notverbindungen mit Schläuchen herzustellen.
Spezielle Hinweisschilder weisen im öffentlichen Raum auf Unterflurhydranten hin.
Der Begriff ist auch für Entnahmestellen für andere Flüssigkeiten, beispielsweise Flugbenzin aus einer Pipeline üblich.
EN:
A hydrant (from Greek ὕδωρ hydor, water ') is a tap for the removal of water from a water distribution system.
As a rule, hydrants established by the water supply are used as part of the central low-water supply of cities and municipalities. It allows users to extract water from the public water supply network (collection water supply) to the fire brigade, but also to public authorities (eg road authorities, municipal companies) and private (eg road cleaning companies, tent festivals).
Hydrants are used to flush, ventilate or relax a pipeline. In the event of a line failure, they are intended to produce emergency connections with hoses.
Special signs in the public area point to underfloor hydrants.
The term is also common for collection points for other liquids, for example, airborne gas from a pipeline.

Dear customer,
“The beauty of the nation” is a series of models of heads.
The model is made in the scale 1/35, it is ready for use in dioramas of the 35th scale. The detailing of the model is appropriate - the details are clearer and larger, which is typical for miniature objects.
This model is designed and prepared for printing.
For designers, the OBJ format is useful, which allows you to use the model as a spare part or base for your own project.
The project “The Beauty of the Nation” is based on the idea of showing the public that every nation, every race and every ethnic group has its own beauty and its own zest, which can be admired and inspired. We idolize beauty and extol it in all sources of realization available to us: be it a sculpture, a painting, poetry, music or cinema. Beauty, in spite of the differences in cultures and the views of the majority, proved that the boundaries, opinions and customs are alien to it. Beauty is an inspiration for contemplation, which entails the creation of even more beautiful things.
Sincerely Yours,
Svetlana

description_text: The Milanese amphitheatre, one of the biggest known in Northern Italy, was built during the first century A.D. In this typically Roman construction, with an elliptical central arena, surrounded by tiered stone bleachers for the spectators, combat between gladiators, fights between men and ferocious animals, public executions for those condemned ad bestias i.e. torn to pieces by wild beasts and even naval battles took place. This imposing building which could hold 20,000 spectators, had its outer ring denuded of building materials during the fifth century A.D. which were re-used in new constructions such as the nearby Basilica of San Lorenzo or to reinforce sections of the city walls.

MORE INFORMATION ABOUT 3D MODELS : A nightlight is a small light fixture, usually electrical, placed for comfort or convenience in dark areas or areas that may become dark at certain times, such as at night or in an emergency. Small long-burning candles serving a similar function are referred to as tealights. People usually use nightlights for the sense of security which having a light on provides, or to relieve fear of the dark, especially in young children. Nightlights are also useful to the general public by revealing the general layout of a room without requiring a major light to be switched on, for avoiding tripping over stairs, obstacles, or pets, or to mark an emergency exit. Exit signs often use tritium in the form of a traser. Homeowners usually place nightlights in bathrooms, kitchens and hallways to avoid turning on the main light fixture, especially late at night, and causing their eyes to adjust to the brighter light.[1]
Some frequent travelers carry small nightlights for temporary installation in their guestroom and bathroom, to avoid tripping or falls in an unfamiliar nighttime environment. Gerontologists have recommended use of nightlights to prevent falls, which can be life-threatening to the elderly.[2]
The low cost of nightlights has enabled a proliferation of different decorative designs, some featuring superheros and fantastical designs, while others feature the basic simplicity of a small luminous disc.

description_text:
News microphone 3D Model, nr. 2 in my collection. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 3868 vertices, 3862 quad faces (7724 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
A low poly bike rack created in Softimage, textured in Substance Painter, and rendered in Keyshot. Made with Unity in mind, but should be fine for any platform that will accept .fbx or .obj
-Game Ready.
-Textures are in 4k, 2k, 1k, and include Albedo Transparency, Metallic Smooth, Ambient Occlusion, and Normal.
-Model has no N-gons, only Quads and Tris, is positioned at the origin [0, 0, 0], has no visible seams or obvious UV stretching, contains no isolated vertices, no coincident vertices or any coincident faces.
-File formats .obj, .fbx, .ksp, and .unitypackage (Unity Package) included.
-Unity package complete with prefabs (just drag into your scene and the materials and textures are already applied. Different LOD's are set to corresponding texture sizes).
-Low poly objects for maximum engine efficiency and compatibility.
-Always priced competitively and reasonable.

description_text:
Rotating turnstile gate 3D Model. 2 individual objects (base, rotating part; so, you can easily rotate or even animate it) sharing the same non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
2 Objects (meshes), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 33220 vertices, 33218 quad faces (66436 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Bring this classic Island hook-and-ring game home and enjoy endless fun while testing your skills. Great fun for all ages.Crafted from 100% Bamboo, big up the environment & post indoors or out.Tee Toss Deluxe (Golf)
Get hooked up in a few minutes, all hardware and easy setup instructions included.
No Overhang, No Problem! Deluxe versions include a 5’ telescoping pole (stainless steel) that inserts seamlessly into the backboard. The telescoping pole includes a builtin cord lock for ease of set up and adjustment. Eliminating the need for an overhang means that Tee Toss can always be mounted in the perfect spot. Add on Camp-Ready Straps or Tailgate Suction Cups to enhance portability. Bring tailgating, camping, parties, beach - Play Anywhere! For the golf enthusiast in the family! Swing the golf ball to land it on the oversized Tee! The same addictive and rewarding play pattern as Tiki Toss, but a bit more challenging. It’s a finesse move. Think putting down hill! Everything included to set up and play in 5 minutes. 100% bamboo backboard. Quick Connect Tee, Golf Ball with connected string, mounting screws, eye hook and cord lock. An Official Tiki Toss Product.
